title: docs: drop stale -p <profile> flag from cron Bot Chat delivery lane
claim: cron-internals.md shows the unowned Bot Chat CLI lane as `hermes [-p <profile>] chat ...`; the code never passes the target profile with -p.

evidence.red: website/docs/developer-guide/cron-internals.md:366 on main: "Without a mailbox owner it retains `hermes [-p <profile>] chat --in ~ -c \"Bot Chat\" --create-if-missing -Q --query-file <tmp>` and normal ownership fencing."
evidence.green: Bundle: `hermes chat --in ~ -c "Bot Chat" --create-if-missing -Q --query-file <tmp>`, launched with HERMES_HOME pinned to the resolved target home (plus `-p default` when that is the root home).
evidence.negative_control: N/A for docs (no executable behaviour). Equivalent check: the stale phrase is present on main and absent on the bundle (grep given in red/green).
evidence.adjacent: python3 website/scripts/check_doc_links.py on the bundle tree: OK (no route-style links). All 7 B1 bundles cherry-pick together onto main cleanly, and each pairs cleanly with B2's current docs2-update/docs2-desktop/docs2-gateway/docs2-memory bundles.
evidence.source: cron/scheduler_delivery.py _deliver_to_bot_chat (:772-950): env = served_profile_child_env(..., target_home=home, inherit_credentials=True) (sets env['HERMES_HOME']=target, tools/environments/local.py:409-411); `if home.parent.name != "profiles": argv += ["-p", "default"]`; then argv += ['chat','--in','~','-c','Bot Chat','--create-if-missing','-Q','--query-file', query_file] (:929-932).

upstream_overlap: No open external PR/issue for this claim (gh search prs/issues; open docs PRs touching the same files edit other sections)

bundle.subject: docs(bot-mode): correct Bot Chat delivery argv, DM stamp and room store name

notes: Fork text dropped the `-p default` root-home detail; rebuilt text keeps it. zh-Hans cron-internals.md has no Bot Chat paragraph. evals/botmode-dm-matrix/README.md quotes a historical message_agent launcher line; left as a record.
